decision.explanation: The provided source documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the director of 'The Avengers'. Document D2 (and card d2:c0) explicitly states James Cameron directed the film, while Document D3 (and card d3:c0) explicitly states Joss Whedon directed it. Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers when competing assertions exist without external verification to resolve the contradiction, both names are included as they are directly supported by the supplied source text.
